name: Mission Control (v3, Velum)
author: Henri Schulz (based on Andy Wei's Mission Control)
description: Mission Control on Velum: its own motion spec, the look (font, accent, badges, captions) from Velum. macOS-style Mission Control with App Exposé and Show Desktop: a folding Spaces strip with live thumbnails, add/remove desktops, drag windows between them, Quick Look, and a finger-following touchpad swipe
